label: Devil's deal + pregnancy (hypnotized) research
description: Screen works worldwide in which a woman knowingly or unknowingly bargains with the devil, a demon or a Satanist/cult intermediary to get pregnant AND is hypnotized or mesmerized (possession, spell-only and potion-only control excluded; minors excluded; plot notes non-explicit). Each record carries the pregnancy outcome. Near-misses, rejections and unverified leads are listed in the research notes, not added.

records.title: Bandh Darwaza
records.subtitle: बंद दरवाज़ा · “The Closed Door”
records.meta: Feature film · India · Hindi · dir. Shyam & Tulsi Ramsay
records.mechanism: Knowing bargain with the demon Nevla (via his witch-servant Mahua) for a child · hypnotized by Nevla at the Kali Pahari ritual
records.confidence_flag: Strong for the deal and the birth (Wikipedia, TMDB, IMDb review, Bharatpedia); the hypnosis of Lajo rests on two fan/wiki sources (Bharatpedia plot: “Neola appears and hypnotises her”; Mental Block screenshot captions), and current English Wikipedia mentions hypnosis only for her daughter Kamya
records.summary: Childless Thakurain Lajo, afraid her husband will remarry, accepts the witch-woman Mahua's offer: the demon Nevla will give her a child, but a daughter must be surrendered to him. At the Kali Pahari ritual Nevla hypnotizes her and she conceives while entranced; she gives birth to Kamya, refuses to hand her over, and is poisoned on Nevla's orders.
records.pregnancy_note: Lajo gives birth to a daughter, Kamya; she is later poisoned on Nevla's orders and dies, while Kamya survives.
records.provenance: Devil's-deal + pregnancy + hypnosis research pass (30 Sep 2026): Mental Block wiki, Wikipedia, Bharatpedia, TMDB, IMDb, TV Tropes and web reviews.
